notes: Hard (rubric total 18). The task is a staged data-close-out pipeline with several competencies that share a hard floor. The agent must (1) relocate documents under /app/inbox into per-class ledger dirs and empty inbox (exact hash-set equality, any leftover fails), (2) iterate EVERY masks.csv row (never a sample) producing one prompt line and one SAM-style per-row mask grid, (3) ship a runnable extraction engine /app/extract.py that actually writes /app/mart.npy with a strict orientation (Nx3, dense-recovered matrix), (4) reuse the sequential iteration constant by importing ITERATIONS from compute_seq via compute_parallel (any inline restating fails an import-evidence check), (5) parse heterogeneous fixtures (csv + json + parquet) into one schema, cross-check fiscal figures to flag the single inconsistent fee, and (6) filter+rank candidate descriptors by proximity to a target within an inclusive tolerance, sorted by a normalized proximity score. Correctness is validated with exact float/structural assertions (quantitative=3). The verifier re-derives every expected output from the raw fixtures on the visible data and on 3 hidden scenarios that change amounts, drop formats (e.g. parquet-only, csv+json-only), reverse rectangle corners (out-of-order coords that must be normalized), test an inclusive tolerance boundary, and shrink to a zero-row input (adversarial=3, hidden_case_generalization=3). The pipeline is strictly staged (docs -> masks -> parse -> mart -> sheet/mismatch/rank) so dependent_stages=2. No resource or interaction pressure.
